title: Crash reporting that is disabled in release, initialised too late, and leaking PII
notes: Four defects stacked, and the ordering is what is being tested. The P0 is the inverted `if (__DEV__)` guard: crash reporting runs only in development, so production reports nothing while the dashboard looks healthy — indistinguishable from a stable app. An agent that leads with the PII issue or with tracesSampleRate has mis-prioritised. Second: init is inside an async bootstrap behind an await on AsyncStorage, so even in dev, startup crashes are missed. Third: sendDefaultPii plus setUser with email and username ships personal data to a third party. Fourth: no release/dist, so nothing can be attributed to a build and source maps can never match.
